Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we have a single record to share with your team. I kept this focused on the bits you flagged as highest priority.

Pain points we heard
- Inaccurate search/extraction from legacy docs (~18–22% false positives on legal clauses) impacting contract review throughput.
- Costly latency spikes when scaling to concurrent review jobs — average end-to-end time now ~6–9s/token at peak.
- Need for strict audit trail and data residency controls for procurement/regulatory reviews.

Desired outcomes (success metrics)
- Reduce false positives by 50% within pilot prompt/eval set (primary metric).
- Maintain 95th percentile token latency < 2s in dedicated pilot window.
- Deliver access logs and prompt-level telemetry for every request (S3/CloudTrail-compatible) during the pilot.

Proposed pilot (30 days + 14-day buffer for access/setup)
- Scope: Extract + clause classification across 3 doc types (contracts, NDAs, amendments).
- Dataset: we’ll work from your subsample (up to 5k documents) — redaction guidance below.
- Models: Redwood hosted LLM (quantized variant) + optional Dedicated pool for latency SLOs.
- Eval: prompt set of 120 golden examples + continuous batch of 800 evaluation queries; weekly snapshot reports.
- Owners: SunPrism product (Dana) — acceptance/labeling; SunPrism infra (procurement) — access approvals; Redwood — infra + prompt engineering (Aditya), rollout and telemetry (Marissa).

Access & timeline (next 3 weeks)
1) Procurement approves minimal access form (CSV with S3 paths) — target by 2027-04-09. (owner: procurement@sunprism.ai)
2) Redwood provides pilot environment + service account instructions and an S3 ingestion template — by 2027-04-12. (owner: Aditya)
3) Initial prompt set + eval harness delivered for review — by 2027-04-15. (owner: Marissa)
4) Pilot start date: 2027-04-19 (30 days), with weekly checkpoints on Fridays.

Compliance & security notes
- We can run the pilot in Redwood Dedicated in eu/us regions as required; granular audit logs will be included.
- Attached is a one-page pilot charter + data checklist (pilot-charter-sunprism.xlsx).
- For procurement: we’ll share SOC 2 and vendor security pack upon NDA completion.

Immediate asks from you
- Confirm pilot start date and whether Dedicated pool is required for the pilot (yes/no).
- Procurement to confirm preferred contract window and any pre-signed DPA template.

Attachments: pilot-charter-sunprism.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks — I’ll queue Marissa to pull together the eval harness once you confirm data access.
